name: Zhang's neighborhoods: four, eight or twelve neighbors
description: Zhang's JEBO rules at β = 10 with four, eight or twelve neighbors, mixed pairs always counted on the eight around (as he does). Zhang: with eight neighbors "the expected waiting time is less than half of that under the von Neumann neighborhood"; twelve is "even a shorter waiting time, although not much shorter". Measured (seeds 1–5, recorded 2026-09-30): the order holds throughout: at step 20, 7,460 mixed pairs with four, 6,230 with eight and 5,420 with twelve; the first step below 8,000 (his potential at 600) is about 17, 10 and 9 (8 seeds), so eight takes 0.6 of four's time, not under half.
